key_highlights: ASX inches higher on energy and big miner rally, but iron ore weakness weighs on BHP sentiment
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; property industry faces 'GFC moment' as RBA signals no rescue
Cost-of-living pressure intensifies: Aussies taking second jobs, pensioners urged to work, household sentiment deteriorating
Gold sector active: Forrestania joins 2Moz club, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory, Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, signalling structural shift in automotive/consumer sector
Qantas engine incident and Spirit of Tasmania debt-to-2052 inquiry highlight transport sector vulnerabilities
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network; BBL privatisation greenlit by Cricket Australia

sectors.trend: Mixed: ASX miners rally on energy strength but iron ore 'crumbles' pressuring BHP; gold miners active with Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser Tassie expansion, Aureka $8.9M Victorian acquisition, and Larvotto NSW gold-antimony-tungsten discovery
sectors.implications: Iron ore weakness caps large-cap miner upside; small/mid-cap gold names benefit from safe-haven flows and project pipeline. Diversification within materials is key.

sectors.trend: RBA explicitly signals it will not rescue property market; accelerating house price falls and rising mortgage stress (second jobs, 'feel poorer' sentiment) elevate credit risk. CFO reduces financial stock holdings post-33% rally.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure from rate cuts vs. rising NPLs in property lending. Banks face a difficult balance; defensive positioning warranted. CFO selling suggests profit-taking at highs.

sectors.trend: Energy stocks lead ASX rally; tanker wars assessed as insufficient to suppress oil; El Nino 'Godzilla' event adds supply risk. US energy security and infrastructure arbitrage themes resonate.
sectors.implications: Supportive for Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX), and coal names. Geopolitical premium persists in oil pricing.

sectors.trend: BYD declares Australia EV tipping point passed; car supply crunch writing off vehicles early and inflating insurance premiums; Gap closes 350 stores globally.
sectors.implications: Structural threat to legacy auto dealers and insurers (WBC.AX, CGF.AX). EV transition accelerates; consumer staples under pressure from cost-of-living squeeze.

sectors.trend: Qantas engine flame incident (surge-and-stall); Spirit of Tasmania operator in debt until 2052 per inquiry; Byron Shire 124-home development cleared by court.
sectors.implications: Qantas (QAN.AX) faces operational and reputational risk. REITs and property developers face a 'GFC moment' backdrop.

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control; TSMC raises guidance on chip demand; Nvidia results reinforce AI outlook; UN flags autonomous drones/AI human rights concerns.
sectors.implications: Media consolidation continues. Global AI/chip strength (TSM, NVDA) supports sentiment but has limited direct ASX exposure beyond CSL's med-tech and small-cap tech.

key_themes: Iron ore price deterioration vs. energy strength creating sector divergence in ASX 20
Property market stress: accelerating price falls, RBA non-intervention, GFC comparisons
Cost-of-living crisis: second jobs, pensioner workforce pressure, household sentiment deterioration
Gold sector project pipeline and M&A activity (Forrestania, Kaiser, Aureka, Larvotto)
EV transition inflection in Australia (BYD tipping point)
Geopolitical risk: tanker wars, El Nino, Trump policy threats, North Korea-Russia bridge
Transport sector operational and financial vulnerabilities (Qantas, Spirit of Tasmania)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse pressuring BHP/RIO/FMG earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; rotate into gold and energy names within materials

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property market 'GFC moment' triggering bank NPL spike and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NAB/CBA/ANZ/WBC NPL trends; favour banks with lower residential exposure; hold quality REITs selectively

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Cost-of-living squeeze suppressing consumer spending and retail sales
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) over discretionary; watch retail sales data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (tanker wars, El Nino, Trump policy threats)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy and gold hedges; monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Transport sector operational risk (Qantas, Spirit of Tasmania debt)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review QAN.AX exposure; avoid distressed transport equities

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven flows and project pipeline momentum
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser Tassie expansion, Aureka acquisition, and Larvotto discovery signal sector strength; gold benefits from property/credit uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore to energy within materials/energy complex
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore 'crumbling' while energy stocks lead ASX; tanker wars and El Nino support oil/LNG pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Selective REIT exposure in healthcare and industrial, avoid residential
opportunities.rationale: Property GFC fears hit residential; healthcare/industrial REITs offer yield with lower rate sensitivity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure (BHP, RIO, FMG)
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore price deterioration threatens earnings; BHP 'mulls suicide' headline signals severe sentiment risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge property-linked credit risk in banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating house price falls and RBA non-intervention raise NPL risk; CFO selling financial stock post-rally confirms caution

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/defensive allocation given cost-of-living and geopolitical uncertainty
defensive_moves.rationale: Household stress, El Nino, and global policy risk create volatile backdrop; 60/40 or 50/50 allocation prudent

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with sector rotation: energy and gold outperform, iron ore and property-linked names underperform. RBA non-intervention on housing removes a key support narrative. Qantas incident and Spirit of Tasmania inquiry add transport-sector noise. Midterm election uncertainty in US adds global risk premium.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore demand shift, property correction, and cost-of-living pressure cap ASX 200 upside. Gold, energy, and healthcare offer relative strength. EV transition (BYD tipping point) reshapes consumer/auto landscape over 12-24 months. AI/chip demand (TSMC, Nvidia) supports global risk appetite but limited ASX direct exposure.
